title.en: How porn became so extreme – and how it’s shaping the sex lives of young people

hook.en:
A few years ago, the singer Billie Eilish opened up on the Howard Stern Show about how she began watching porn around age 11.

“I’m so angry that porn is so loved, and I’m so angry at myself for thinking that it was ok,” she said.

sections.body_en:
Eilish became addicted to porn, and it led to problems. “The first few times I had sex, I was not saying no to things that were not good,” she said. She had nightmares because the content she was watching was so violent and abusive.

Online porn is a multi-million dollar business, driven by algorithms designed to keep people clicking for more. These algorithms push more and more extreme content, often for free, to people who didn’t go searching for it. This can include strangulation, exploitation or incest porn, that’s often misogynistic and racist too.

“If you take incest and strangulation, we can look at content studies from the 1980s, for example, when there was hardly any of that material,” Clare McGlynn, professor of law at Durham University in the UK, tells The Conversation Weekly podcast. “Today both incest and strangulation becomes mainstream.”

In the UK, the government will ban the possession and publication of incest and strangulation porn from early November. McGlynn, who worked with civil society groups to push the regulation of extreme content, says it’s a “huge step” that sends a message about the harms of “normalising sexual violence”.

McGlynn, who has written a recent book about the rise of extreme porn, says large online porn platforms are pushing people towards more and more extreme content.

Their business model is to keep you engaged. They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content … unfortunately, that seems to be what our kind of base instincts go for and what does actually engage us to keep us searching.

Their business model is to keep you engaged. They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content … unfortunately, that seems to be what our kind of base instincts go for and what does actually engage us to keep us searching.

McGlynn says an abundance of extreme and violent porn is shaping the sex lives of young people, and it can lead to an increased risk of problematic behaviour.

There’s a study that followed 16,000 young people, showing that high porn use, particularly at a young age, is a big risk factor in problematic sexual behaviour of young teenage boys. And there’s studies in Australia and the US … showing that the more porn they watch, the more strangulation they see, and then the more they identify that they act out the strangulation.

summary.vi: Ngành công nghiệp khiêu dâm trực tuyến đang sử dụng các thuật toán để giữ chân người dùng bằng cách liên tục đẩy những nội dung ngày càng cực đoan và bạo lực. Việc tiếp xúc sớm với các nội dung này gây ra những ảnh hưởng tiêu cực sâu sắc đến tâm lý và đời sống tình dục của giới trẻ, làm gia tăng các hành vi bạo lực trong thực tế. Các chính phủ và nhà quản lý đang bắt đầu đưa ra các biện pháp thắt chặt quản lý nhằm ngăn chặn tác hại từ những nội dung độc hại này.
summary.fr: Propulsée par des algorithmes visant à maximiser l'engagement, la pornographie en ligne diffuse des contenus de plus en plus violents et extrêmes. Des pratiques autrefois marginales, comme la strangulation ou les scénarios incestueux, sont devenues courantes, poussant le Royaume-Uni à en prohiber la détention. Des experts alertent sur cette « normalisation des violences sexuelles » qui affecte directement les adolescents : des études démontrent en effet qu'une exposition précoce altère la perception du consentement et accroît le risque de reproduire ces agressions dans leur propre vie intime.
summary.de: Kommerzielle Online-Pornoplattformen setzen gezielt auf Algorithmen, die Nutzer durch immer extremere und verstörendere Inhalte an den Bildschirm fesseln. Was früher eine Randerscheinung war, darunter Darstellungen von Strangulation, Inzest und offener Gewalt, gehört heute zum Mainstream. Recherchen und Aussagen von Betroffenen wie Sängerin Billie Eilish verdeutlichen die gravierenden psychischen Folgen eines verfrühten Konsums. Rechtswissenschaftlerin Clare McGlynn warnt vor der fortschreitenden Normalisierung sexualisierter Gewalt: Studien zeigen einen deutlichen Zusammenhang zwischen exzessivem Pornografiekonsum bei Jugendlichen und problematischem Verhalten im echten Leben. Gesetzliche Verbote extremer Inhalte, wie sie in Großbritannien eingeführt werden, markieren daher einen wichtigen Schritt gegen die toxische Dynamik dieser Plattformen.
summary.es: El auge de la pornografía digital extrema responde a modelos de negocio diseñados para retener la atención mediante algoritmos que promueven contenidos cada vez más violentos y explícitos. Especialistas y testimonios de figuras públicas advierten que la exposición temprana y constante a este material normaliza conductas perjudiciales, afectando la vida íntima y la percepción de los límites en los jóvenes. Diversos estudios vinculan este consumo intensivo con riesgos significativos en el comportamiento sexual adolescente, lo que ha impulsado medidas legislativas en países como el Reino Unido para prohibir y sancionar la difusión de material violento.

keyPoint.en: Algorithmic porn platforms are like a fast-food chain serving increasingly toxic ingredients just to keep you at the table. [p:Can you consciously limit your exposure to digital content that distorts reality]?
keyPoint.vi: Các nền tảng khiêu dâm thuật toán giống như một cửa hàng đồ ăn nhanh phục vụ những thành phần ngày càng độc hại chỉ để giữ chân bạn lại. [p:Bạn có thể chủ động giới hạn việc tiếp xúc với nội dung kỹ thuật số bóp méo thực tế không]?

en: Identify personal triggers that lead to consuming online pornography.
Discuss the impacts of media consumption openly with trusted peers.
Explore educational resources regarding healthy relationships and boundaries.
vi: Xác định các tác nhân cá nhân dẫn đến việc tiêu thụ nội dung khiêu dâm trực tuyến.
Thảo luận cởi mở về tác động của việc tiếp thu truyền thông với bạn bè đáng tin cậy.
Khám phá các nguồn tài nguyên giáo dục về các mối quan hệ lành mạnh và ranh giới.

en.algorithms: Automated computer systems that select and recommend media content to keep users engaged.
en.strangulation: The act of choking or constricting someone's neck, depicted as extreme sexual content.
en.incest porn: Sexually explicit material depicting acts between family members or people presented as relatives.
en.misogynistic: Reflecting hatred, mistrust, or prejudice against women.
en.content studies: Academic research analyzing the themes, types, and prevalence of material in media.
en.civil society groups: Independent organizations and advocacy groups working outside government to protect public welfare.
en.polarising: Causing people to divide sharply into opposing or extreme viewpoints.
en.base instincts: Primitive, biological urges and basic emotional impulses that drive automatic human reactions.
en.risk factor: A condition or variable that increases the chance of developing negative or harmful outcomes.
en.problematic sexual behaviour: Inappropriate, aggressive, or non-consensual sexual actions that cause harm to oneself or others.
en.academic appointment: An official role or faculty position at a university or research institution.
en.rss feed: A standardized web format used to distribute regularly updated digital content and podcast audio.
